_comment: Browser sign-in config. Deliberately not shipped configured: the code-to-token exchange host sees the resulting user token, so that exchange should only ever run on infrastructure YOU control. Create a personal Slack app (docs/OWN-APP.md), deploy your own proxy (oauth-proxy/README.md), then write ~/.config/omarchy-slack/oauth.json with client_id, proxy_url, and optionally port. The 'Sign in with Slack' button appears once that file validates. Without it, paste a token instead.
